chunks: And from him, from Safwan, from Mis'mam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
He said to me: 'When you enter Mecca, complete [your prayer] on the day you enter.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on prayer length when first entering Mecca for Hajj or Umrah?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on expiations for pilgrims' errors, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) via Safwan establishes the Sunnah of offering full (non-shortened) prayers upon entering Mecca. This practice distinguishes the pilgrim's state upon arrival from the standard travel prayer, emphasizing reverence for the holy city and serving as a preparatory spiritual act before commencing the core rituals of Hajj or Umrah.
